worker_target_description: Experiment 1 (minimal groups), Hypothesis 2 planned contrast of self versus the other three conditions, excluding altruists; p. 806 (article PDF page 9). Fairness judgment of the same transgression. The supplied page locator and exclusion condition identify this test.
worker_notes: Identity verified independently from first-page title, Claire E. Robertson, Madison Akles, Jay J. Van Bavel, Psychological Science 35(7), 798–813 (2024), DOI 10.1177/09567976241246552. Supplied text is a full primary research article with methods, results, discussion and references; no PDF was supplied. Only n_r and reported_success assigned; other fields are placeholders. Target matching uses the described comparison and page locator, not row order or numeric matching. PDF page 9 corresponds to printed p. 806 and the Experiment 1 Hypothesis 2 extension contrast. Experiment 2 has a separate analogous contrast on p. 809. Candidate analytic N: p. 806 explicitly says final sample size 536 in the power/equivalence discussion for the Hypothesis 1 contrast, whereas p. 805 says final sample 590 and identifies fair/altruistic self participants n = 47 and n = 4. Diagnostic arithmetic 590 - 47 - 4 = 539 is not an accepted analytic N and is not a sum of explicit mutually exclusive final groups. The Hypothesis 2 test is printed F(1, 536) = 1.27, p = .26, η2 = .002; no N is inferred from these df. Neither 536 nor 539 is assigned as target analytic N without clarification of the discrepancy. The reported_success failed is scoped to transgressors-only individual moral hypocrisy, using the authors narrative verdict; their overall individual-hypocrisy summary is mixed when inclusive and excluded analyses are combined.
